WITH primera_compra AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cliente_id,
        MIN(p.fecha) AS fecha_primer_pedido
    FROM clientes c
    JOIN pedidos p ON c.cliente_id = p.cliente_id
    WHERE p.estado = 'entregado'
      AND strftime('%Y-%m', p.fecha) = '2025-01'
    GROUP BY c.cliente_id
),
clientes_con_segunda_compra AS (
    SELECT 
        pc.cliente_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_pedidos_entregados
    FROM primera_compra pc
    JOIN pedidos p ON pc.cliente_id = p.cliente_id
    WHERE p.estado = 'entregado'
      AND p.fecha > pc.fecha_primer_pedido
      AND julianday(p.fecha) - julianday(pc.fecha_primer_pedido) <= 90
    GROUP BY pc.cliente_id
),
total_clientes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM primera_compra
),
clientes_con_segunda_compra_total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM clientes_con_segunda_compra
)
SELECT 
    CAST(tcs.total AS REAL) / CAST(tc.total AS REAL) AS tasa
FROM clientes_con_segunda_compra_total tcs, total_clientes tc;
